london-motorcycle-escapes-hastings-cliff.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: This High point near West Mersea → Scenic stretch in Maldon stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

sections.to: Near Kettering, on the way back
sections.advice: Scenic stretch in Maldon → Near Kettering, on the way back is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

sections.from: Near Kettering, on the way back

sections.advice: Photo stop near Bicester → Near Woodford Green can flow quickly, but only if you keep village limits and junction sightlines sacred. Fast connectors are where rides get untidy when fatigue creeps in.

safetyMarkers.note: Respect posted limits and assume enforcement near villages, viewpoints and main-road joins.

sections.advice: back through Izquierda E. de Santonje → Los Sacristanes is 56 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

places-los-sacristanes-cueva-de-la-plata.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-los-sacristanes-cueva-de-la-plata.story: From Nerpio it runs 257 km to Nerpio; allow about 4 h 26 of riding. The stops in between: Izquierda E. de Santonje, Cueva de la Plata and back through Izquierda E. de Santonje. The highest point is about 1,400 m. The line favours views over speed.
